question: What is the meaning of dismantling in relation to circularity at end of product use period?
data_group: circularity at end of product use period
description: Dismantling in relation to circularity at the end of the product use period refers to the process of taking apart a product in a way that it is not intended to be reassembled and made operational. This process allows for some parts of the product to be reused after dismantling.
